stack_of_papers_table_explanation.interpretation: Thirteen input prompts explicitly request a stack of papers and fourteen rewrites do. The rewrite-only case adds stacked paper to cashmere__laptop_FrontCloseUp::p3. The frozen paper_documents group has fourteen rows because tassel__printer_FrontWide::p3 declares worksheets rather than a stack. The former zero input count came from an overly literal regular expression and has been corrected.
